create_Omni3D_dataset: create an Omni3D dataset object from COCO annotation JSON files with optional category and visibility filter settings
load_omni3d_json: load an Omni3D JSON dataset file and return Detectron2-compatible dataset dictionaries with 3D bounding box annotations
register_simple_dataset: register an Omni3D dataset with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog using a name and filter settings
filter_annotations_is_ignore: check whether a 3D annotation should be ignored based on depth, truncation, visibility, and dimension thresholds
register_model_metadata: register and store model category metadata mapping dataset category IDs to contiguous IDs for training
